description: Offline heuristic-only static review rules. These are not confirmed vulnerabilities.

rules.title: Dynamic code execution primitive
rules.recommendation: Confirm inputs are trusted; avoid dynamic execution and enforce CSP.

rules.title: Potential HTML injection sink
rules.recommendation: Trace dataflow and prefer safe DOM APIs or context-aware sanitization.

rules.title: Wildcard postMessage target
rules.recommendation: Validate message origin and use a specific trusted targetOrigin.

rules.title: Potential sensitive browser storage
rules.recommendation: Review token handling, lifetime, XSS exposure and storage alternatives.

rules.title: Non-TLS external HTTP reference
rules.recommendation: Confirm whether network transmission needs HTTPS; localhost is excluded.

rules.title: Potential TLS certificate verification bypass
rules.recommendation: Confirm certificate validation cannot be disabled in production.

rules.title: Shell invocation review
rules.recommendation: Use argument arrays and avoid shell=True with dynamic input.

rules.title: Unverified QR fallback indicator
rules.recommendation: Inspect the trust boundary: a frontend QR fallback is not proof of signed official verification.
